name: Hagen am Teutoburger Wald (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hagen am Teutoburger Wald (a white oak leaf on red and a half red wheel on white).
history: The arms, designed by Ulf-Dietrich Korn, were granted by the Landkreis Osnabrück in 1976; the half wheel and the colours white and red recall the former prince-bishopric of Osnabrück.

features.role: Hagen am Teutoburger Wald arms — oak leaf and half wheel
